# What worked

Measured gains, one bullet per result; a bullet names every change that produced it.

## Cost and speed

* [The branch exit runs a peer review and one coder dispatch](notes/2026-11-01-the-branch-exit-runs-a-peer-review-and-one-coder.md): **cuts tokens by 82% (23.2M → 4.1M)** [skill/verify-branch, shared/closing-phases, script/verify-prep, script/verify-log] ([2026-11-01-peer-review-plus-one-coder-dispatch-nits-included](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-11-01-peer-review-plus-one-coder-dispatch-nits-included.md)) - 2026-11-01 [watch: TOO FEW]
* [The plan reviewer runs on about two fifths fewer tokens without the batch-your-tree-checks instruction](notes/2026-09-13-the-plan-reviewer-s-instruction-to-batch-its-tree.md): **cuts tokens by 38% (1.3M → 800k)** [agent/plan-reviewer] ([2026-09-12-tokbatch-1](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-09-12-tokbatch-1.md)) - 2026-09-13 [watch: no watch]
* [One `coder` now builds a full-stack change, with no frontend/backend fence](notes/2026-08-04-fe-be-coder-split-one-unfenced-coder-for-fullstack.md): **cuts cost by 36% ($140.93 → $89.97)** [agent/coder] ([2026-07-12-seam-ab-r2](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-07-12-seam-ab-r2.md)) - 2026-08-04 [watch: no watch]
* [/code asks the user through say.md, and an adopted plan change gets a plan-edit coder before the review](notes/2026-10-19-code-asks-the-user-through-say-md-and-an-adopted.md): **cuts wall-clock by 31% (3680 → 2540)** [skill/code, script/code-step] ([2026-10-19-plan-impact-bench-for-code-one-disagreement-asked](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-10-19-plan-impact-bench-for-code-one-disagreement-asked.md)) - 2026-10-19 [watch: BETTER, closed kept]
* [/review launches the scripted review loop](notes/2026-10-30-review-launches-the-scripted-review-loop.md) and [/code now runs its review loop as a script instead of an agent](notes/2026-10-27-code-runs-the-review-loop-as-a-script.md): **cuts cost by 29% ($2.96 → $2.11)** [skill/review, script/review-fix, script/review-loop-script, script/code-step, script/handback, script/format-changed] ([2026-10-26-scripted-review-loop-with-bounded-re-review-vs](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-10-26-scripted-review-loop-with-bounded-re-review-vs.md)) - 2026-10-30 [watch: TOO FEW]; 2026-10-27 [watch: TOO FEW]
* [The coder's preloaded core now holds its contract only](notes/2026-09-14-the-coder-s-preloaded-core-is-now-its-contract.md): **cuts tokens by 18% (950k → 780k)** [shared/plan-reading, skill/coder-core] ([2026-09-14-codercore-1](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-09-14-codercore-1.md)) - 2026-09-14 [watch: no watch]
* [/code runs as plain prompt steps with no code-step script](notes/2026-10-31-code-runs-as-plain-prompt-steps-with-no-code-step.md): **cuts cost by 15% ($7.86 → $6.66)** [skill/code, script/code-step, agent/code-fork, skill/eng-spec, agent/spec-criteria, script/review-loop-script, script/handback] ([2026-10-31-code-skill-without-the-code-step-script-8-runs-per](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-10-31-code-skill-without-the-code-step-script-8-runs-per.md)) - 2026-10-31 [watch: TOO FEW]

## Quality

* [`code-reviewer` now runs on opus and catches defects sonnet missed](notes/2026-08-08-code-reviewer-pinned-to-opus.md): **raises substantive true findings per review by 226% (1.583 → 5.167)** [agent/code-reviewer] - 2026-08-08 [watch: no watch]
